prose.headline: Corsair Gaming bounced on heavy volume: buy $13.08, target $14.27 by Oct 26, stop $12.63.

The longer trend is up: higher highs and higher lows, with price far above the 200-day at $8.67 and above the VWAP since the last earnings at $12.85.

RSI at 48 and MACD still under its signal say momentum has not caught up with price yet, so this is an early entry, not a late one. The 20-day at $13.50 and the busiest price at $13.56 are the first lids; the broken support line, now overhead at $14.27, is the target. Lose $12.63 on a close and the bounce failed.

story: Insperity fell 4.6% on 1.26× normal volume Monday and lost the 50-day at $50.24, but it landed squarely on its rising trendline at $47.91 and held the 20-day retest at $48.47. The bottom of the high-volume range at $48.67 sits right there too, a three-way floor under a stock still far above the 200-day at $39.16.

RSI dropped to 49 from 59, a hard reset, yet MACD still sits above its signal. The VWAP since the last earnings at $50.58 and the busiest price at $50.41 are the first lids. story: Bumble broke up through its resistance line and has nearly doubled from its 20-day at $3.49. RSI is 90 for a second session and volume is running 1.68× normal: a vertical, crowded move with the price at $5.96, right under the 52-week high at $5.98. The reclaim of the 20-day on Oct 12 started it.

Nobody should buy that candle. The trade is a reset into the VWAP since the last earnings at $4.55, where the post-report base sits. A pullback to $4.66 that holds that line resets the setup with defined risk, and a measured move of four daily ranges to $4.90 is the first target. MACD far above its signal says the trend itself is not broken.

story: Three sessions ago Employers Holdings broke out of a descending triangle and closed at $51.26, a whisker under the 52-week high at $52.60. Both averages held their retests on Oct 8 and sit together at $49.03 and $49.01, with the 200-day far below at $45.54 and a rising trendline at $47.89. Price has cleared the top of the high-volume range at $50.30.

The catch is the money flow, which has slipped while price climbed. RSI holds at 68 with price stretched two ranges above the averages. That argues for a dip entry at $50.70, not a chase at the high. MACD above its signal keeps the trend in charge. The recent swing high at $52.59 is the target, and a close under $49.94 means the breakout failed.
